constraint.hint: The constraint can be a number, a cell or range of the same size, or a formula. int, bin and dif make the cells whole numbers, 0 or 1, or all different (1 to n).
constraint.noRhs: Enter a number, a cell reference or a formula
constraint.oneRange: Enter one range on this sheet, like $B$4 or $B$4:$B$6
constraint.sameSize: Use one cell, or a range the same size as the cell reference
engineNote.evolutionary: For models built on functions that are not smooth, such as IF, lookups or rounding. Needs bounds on the variable cells and searches with a population of trial solutions.
engineNote.grg: For smooth nonlinear models. Starts from the current values and finds a locally optimal solution; turn on Multistart in Options to search from many starting points.
engineNote.simplex: For linear models: the objective and every constraint must be sums of the variable cells times constants. Finds the best solution and supports sensitivity analysis.
model.hint: Load reads a model saved in cells. Save writes this model down a column from the cell given, in {count} cells: formulas you can read and check, with the options in the last cell.
model.loadConfirm: Replace the current model with the one in these cells?
model.loadRange: Enter the range that holds a saved model, like $H$2:$H$8
model.saveConfirm: The {count} cells from {cell} down are not all empty. Replace their contents with the model?
model.saveRange: Enter the top cell of an empty column range to save the model to
model.title: Load/Save Model
noConstraints: No constraints yet. Choose Add to limit the cells the model uses.
options.errors.iterations: Enter a whole number of iterations, or leave it blank
options.errors.maxTime: Enter a number of seconds, or leave it blank for no limit
options.errors.mutationRate: Enter a mutation rate from 0 to 1
options.errors.seed: Enter a whole number for the seed (0 picks a new one each time)
options.errors.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number, or leave it blank
options.title: Solver Options
progress.title: Solving…
resetConfirm: Clear the objective, variable cells, constraints and options?
results.continuousOnly: Available for a continuous model solved by Simplex LP or GRG Nonlinear
results.grgNote: GRG Nonlinear finds a locally optimal solution. Another starting point, or Multistart in Options, may find a better one.
results.noSolution: There is no solution to report on
results.reportsAdded: {count, plural, one {Report added before this sheet} other {{count} reports added before this sheet}}
results.simplexNote: Simplex LP found the best solution of this linear model.
results.title: Solver Results
results.trialSolutions: {count, plural, one {# trial solution} other {# trial solutions}}
